In this update:
  • New special stickers to unlock costumes for Swoop and OddSock in LittleBigPlanet3(tm)!
  • There's a Wolf costume hiding in the Mega Lucky Chests! Go get him! RRRAAARRRRRRR!
  • As you run for your life, you will notice The Gardens now look even more beautiful!
  • Loads of bug fixes and tweaks, including a streamlined tutorial to help you escape that dastardly Negtivitron!
